proof_scope: The anonymization pipeline replaces policy values across CSV/JSON/TXT/SQLite, verifies the output corpus, writes report.json, and fails closed on unsupported input.

claims.proves: demo runs all four formats and exits 0; a mounted run produces a verified report.json; unsupported input exits non-zero.
claims.does_not_prove: terabyte/petabyte scale, the production cloud design, or overlap/protected-value precedence beyond current starter behavior.

capability_claims.description: The bundled demo processes all four formats at two sizes and verifies output.
A run over a fixture corpus writes report.json with verification_passed true.
An unsupported input type makes the run exit non-zero.

cases.name: run-produces-verified-report
command: w=$(mktemp -d); .venv/bin/python fixtures/generate_fixture.py "$w/input" --records 200 && .venv/bin/anonymization-trial run --input "$w/input" --output "$w/output" && python3 -c "import json,sys; r=json.load(open('$w/output/report.json')); print('VERIFIED' if r['verification_passed'] else 'FAILED')"

cases.name: fails-closed-on-unsupported-input
command: w=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$w/input/corpus"; echo '{}' > "$w/input/policy.json"; echo x > "$w/input/corpus/bad.parquet"; .venv/bin/anonymization-trial run --input "$w/input" --output "$w/output"; test $? -ne 0 && echo FAILCLOSED_OK
